about.title: Professional profile, technical dedication, and an engineering ethos.
about.paragraph1: I am a Computer and Network Engineering (TKJ) student at SMK Telkom Malang (Moklet A'35). My coursework and independent research concentrate on network topology design, MikroTik & Cisco routing, Linux server administration, and modern full-stack web architectures.
about.paragraph2: I believe the most valuable frontier in technology lies at the convergence of resilient network infrastructure and intuitive software interfaces. Through a research-oriented approach and extensive hands-on lab experiments, I consistently sharpen my technical capabilities to deliver high-performance, real-world digital solutions.
about.quote: Stay humble in learning, precise in design, and proven in execution.

profilePage.introP1: A Computer and Network Engineering (TKJ) vocational student at SMK Telkom Malang focusing on computer network architecture, Debian Linux server administration, and modern web systems built with Next.js and TypeScript.
profilePage.introP2: To me, technology engineering bridges systemic logic and practical execution—transforming real laboratory and industry challenges into resilient, clean, and measurable infrastructure.
profilePage.deskNoteQuote: High dedication to technical precision, continuous learning, and a commitment to solving real engineering challenges.
profilePage.polaroidSub: Breathe in nature, recharge logic & clarity.
profilePage.statusText: Grade 10 TKJ Student • Exploring Routing Protocols, Containerization, & Modern Web Engineering.
profilePage.id02Text: Computer and Network Engineering (TKJ), Cohort 35 (Moklet A'35), SMK Telkom Malang.
profilePage.id03Text: East Java, Indonesia. Focused on Sawojajar networking labs and dedicated development workstation.
profilePage.id04Subtitle: Computer Networking • Web Engineering • Systems Administration
profilePage.id04Text: Passionate about exploring the synergy between physical networking layers and modern web application architecture.
profilePage.id06Text: Architectural documentary photography, open-source topology analysis, computational literature, and youth innovation forums.
profilePage.principlesSubtitle: Four professional principles that guide my approach to network topology configurations and software systems architecture.
profilePage.p1Desc: Clear communication and proactive curiosity toward technical documentation accelerate complex problem resolution and enhance team efficiency.
profilePage.p2Desc: Theoretical concepts must be validated through physical hardware configuration, live lab testing, and benchmarked simulations.
profilePage.p3Desc: Optimal outcomes emerge from teamwork and mentorship; every technical obstacle serves as a foundation for elevating system reliability.
profilePage.p4Desc: Documenting configuration steps, topology schemas, and debugging processes creates structured reference material for peers and developers.
profilePage.t1Desc: Ambient and instrumental compositions that sustain deep focus during system architecture design and network topology configuration.
profilePage.t2Desc: Hot coffee and a distraction-free environment supporting in-depth study of technical documentation and clean code refactoring.
profilePage.t3Desc: Ensuring a clean terminal environment and isolated workspace sessions before initiating builds or deployments.
profilePage.t4Desc: RFC 793 (TCP State Machine) documentation & Node.js event-driven architecture for advanced backend mastery.
profilePage.closingDesc: Always open to technical discussions regarding network architecture, open-source software systems, or strategic collaboration opportunities.
profilePage.closingSign: — Naufal Nizar De Bian, Malang, East Java.
